description: This Java class 'UiUtils' provides utility methods for UI operations such as saving images, creating buttons, centering windows, and handling repaint/layout updates within a Swing-based application. It includes methods for screenshot capture, file chooser configuration, and UI component manipulation.

classes.name: UiUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for UI operations in a Swing application.

methods.name: saveImageWithPrompt
methods.description: Prompts user to select a file location and saves the provided component as a PNG image.

methods.name: getFileChooser
methods.description: Creates and configures a JFileChooser with a specified file filter.

methods.name: saveImage
methods.description: Captures a screenshot of a component and saves it as a PNG file.

methods.name: getScreenShot
methods.description: Generates a BufferedImage screenshot of a given component.

methods.name: setPauseButtonText
methods.description: Sets the text of a pause button to 'Resume' or 'Pause' based on the paused state.

methods.name: centerWindow
methods.description: Centers a window on the screen.

methods.name: trueRepaint
methods.description: Forces a component or container to invalidate, validate, and repaint.

methods.name: trueLayout
methods.description: Invalidates, validates, and repaints a component.

methods.name: setTwoLineToolTip
methods.description: Sets a tooltip with two lines of text on a JComponent.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Wraps a JComponent inside a JPanel.

methods.name: createSaveImageButton
methods.description: Creates a JButton labeled 'save image' with mnemonic 's'.

methods.name: loadIcon
methods.description: Loads an ImageIcon from a resource path.

methods.name: invokeAndWait
methods.description: Executes a Runnable on the Event Dispatch Thread, waiting if necessary.

methods.name: showLoadingMessage
methods.description: Adds a 'Loading...' label to a JPanel.

methods.name: createPauseButton
methods.description: Creates a pause button with mnemonic 'p'.

methods.name: createClearButton
methods.description: Creates a clear button with mnemonic 'c'.
